# Flutter

<!-- Generated by bazel run //tools/docs/languages:languages_bin -- --write from flutter/lang.json and flutter/defs.bzl. Do not edit. -->

This page helps you build, test and check Flutter code with rules_dx.

## Quick start

`MODULE.bazel` sits at the root of your repository and lists the Bazel modules, meaning external dependencies, that your project uses. Add `rules_dx` to it:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<release>")
```

Then let dx set up the rest, as in the [Quickstart](../../README.md#quickstart):

```sh
bazel run @rules_dx//:dx -- init --apply
```

For a Flutter project, `MODULE.bazel` then looks like this:

```python
module(name = "my_project")

bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<release>")
```

A `BUILD.bazel` file declares targets: the libraries, binaries and tests that Bazel builds. This one is a small Flutter package from [`flutter/tests/consumer`](https://github.com/devhusdk/rules_dx/blob/main/flutter/tests/consumer/BUILD.bazel):

```python
load("@rules_dx//flutter:defs.bzl", "flutter_library")

flutter_library(
    name = "consumer",
    package_name = "consumer",
    srcs = ["lib/greet.dart"],
)
```

Build and test everything. `//...` means every target in the repository:

```sh
tools/dx test //...
```

## Dependencies

### Setup

rules_dx depends on rules_flutter and registers its toolchains, so you need no
Flutter, Dart or Android SDK on your machine. Start a project:

```sh
dx init --apply demo-app
```

Your `MODULE.bazel` needs only `bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx")`. You add no
`rules_flutter` `bazel_dep`, no `flutter.toolchain` tag and no engine
`use_repo`. [`tests/consumer`](https://github.com/devhusdk/rules_dx/blob/main/flutter/tests/consumer) is a minimal project.

When your code imports pub packages, add a `pubspec.lock` and declare a hub
with the `pub` extension. A hub is a Bazel repository that holds one target
per locked package:

```python
pub = use_extension("@rules_dx//flutter:extensions.bzl", "pub")
pub.lock(
    name = "my_flutter_deps",
    lock = "//app:pubspec.lock",
)
use_repo(pub, "my_flutter_deps")
```

To write or refresh `pubspec.lock` for a package directory, run `pub get`
from the pinned Flutter SDK:

```sh
bazel run @rules_flutter//flutter:pub -- get --directory <dir>
```

## Packaging

### Apps

- `flutter_web_app` builds the web bundle.
- `flutter_android_app` builds an Android app with `android_binary`, so no
  Gradle runs. Set `android_abi` to `arm64`, the default, or `x64`. It needs
  the managed `androidsdk` override from rules_dx.
- `flutter_ios_app` and every target it creates build only on a macOS host.
  Other hosts skip them as incompatible.

### Profile builds

To build a `flutter_application` in profile mode, write a transition that
sets `@rules_dx//flutter:profile` to `True` and `//command_line_option:compilation_mode`
to `opt`, and apply it to the app's label attribute.

## Rules

`load` brings rules into a `BUILD.bazel` file. Load the ones you use from `@rules_dx//flutter:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//flutter:defs.bzl", "flutter_gen_l10n", "flutter_library", "flutter_test")
```

### `flutter_gen_l10n`

Re-exported from `@rules_flutter//flutter:defs.bzl`.

### `flutter_library`

```python
flutter_library(name, srcs = None, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Thin wrapper over flutter_library; fonts_json assets must come from font_files.

### `flutter_test`

```python
flutter_test(name, *, srcs = None, main = None, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Thin wrapper over flutter_test. main is name.dart, then test/name.dart, else the single src.

### `flutter_application`

```python
flutter_application(name, *, srcs = None, main = None, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Thin wrapper over flutter_application. main is name.dart, then lib/main.dart, else the single src.

### `flutter_web_app`

```python
flutter_web_app(name, *, srcs = None, main = None, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Thin wrapper over flutter_web_app. main is name.dart, then lib/main.dart, else the single src.

### `flutter_web_bundle`

```python
flutter_web_bundle(name, **kwargs)
```

Thin wrapper over flutter_web_bundle, for dart2js or canvaskit builds.

### `flutter_android_app`

```python
flutter_android_app(name, application, package_name, android_abi = "arm64", visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Thin wrapper over flutter_android_app. An unknown android_abi fails when the target is analyzed.

### `flutter_ios_app`

```python
flutter_ios_app(name, application, bundle_id, **kwargs)
```

Thin wrapper over flutter_ios_app.

## Tools and package files

dx runs these tools and reads these package files for Flutter:

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Tools | none |
| Ecosystems | pub |
| Manifests | `pubspec.yaml` |
| Lockfiles | `pubspec.lock` |

## Platforms

Flutter builds and tests on:

- Linux arm64
- Linux x86_64
- macOS arm64
- Windows x86_64

## API docs

`tools/dx docs` builds the API docs with `dart doc`; see [docs](../cli/commands/docs.md).

To declare a docs target yourself, load the rule behind it:

```python
load("@rules_dx//dart:defs.bzl", "dart_doc_shard")
```

### `dart_doc_shard`

Converts one dart_library public API into a DocIr shard with the pinned `dart doc`.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lib` | `label` | yes | The documented dart_library. |
| `package` | `string` | no | Package segment of the symbol ids; defaults to the Dart package name of lib. |
| `_extract` | `label` | no |  |

`dx docs` runs the pinned `dart doc` on every `flutter_library` with a `lib/`
source. To declare a docs target yourself, use `dart_doc_shard` from
`@rules_dx//dart:defs.bzl`. `dart doc` is not available on
`windows_arm64`, where rules_flutter ships no SDK.
